title: perf(cpu): reduce unweighted reconstruction peak RSS with one-frame scratch
body:
CPU unweighted reconstruction materializes a corrected image for every movie frame and retains that stack through dose weighting. Stream the existing interpolation through one float scratch frame, preserving per-frame float rounding, original model time and ascending total/even/odd additions.

Independent of #177, based on main 116eb04. Refs #10. Production/test commit: 5a6812b. Evidence-only head: e8f3eb8.

Measured tutorial (3710x3838x24, 5x5, j4, dose + noDW + even/odd), six alternating measured pairs after one warmup per arm:
- Maximum observed peak RSS: 4.388 -> 3.134 GiB; every measured pair reduces RSS by 28.56-29.02%.
- Wall medians: 54.196 / 51.480 s (main/candidate). Paired median -4.894 s, 96.875% interval [-13.533,+8.819] s: NO resolved speedup or slowdown.
- Four synthetic global/5x5 j1/j4 configurations, six pairs each: exact products and 21.68-26.87% lower paired peak RSS; every timing interval crosses zero, including higher candidate j1 medians.

All 35 benchmark output-tree comparisons pass. Across benchmarks, known-motion and one diagnostic pair, 214 canonical MRC/STAR file pairs match exactly under the existing writer-clock/root normalization. No tolerance relaxed and no outlier removed.

Focused bitwise, parity, immutable-alias, temporal-index, float-rounding and live-allocation controls pass. Native GitHub Linux CI run 508 is green on production commit 5a6812b: 53/53 CTests, known-motion aggregate, canonical fixture and smoke/failure checks. The pre-existing noisy characterization accuracy failure remains visible. CUDA compile passes; NO native GPU execution. Local CTest is 51/53, with the same ProfilingKit and MultiGpuScheduling PID/proc failures reproduced on unchanged main.

These are bounded fallback measurements: this container's /proc PID view prevents standard per-PID ownership certification. Physical-host isolation is not certified, so this is NOT a clean mcprof verdict. The evidence commit changes documentation only.

The saving applies when unweighted/noDW/even-odd reconstruction is needed; dose-only jobs without those products already skip that stage. Keep draft for source review and clean-host representative measurements. No merge or issue closure.

[Full results and raw evidence](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/blob/perf/cpu-streamed-unweighted/docs/cpu_stream_20261014/README.md)
